column1: # What reviewers of this kind of product report that the general lists do not know (rules pc3; read by product_category.py).
# Columns, separated by TABS: term | label | severity | reason
#   term      regular expression read against the normalized sentence, as whole words
#   label     safety, defect, counterfeit, quality or not_as_described
#   severity  1 minor, 2 material, 3 critical. An added safety term is an unspecified safety concern: counted and quoted,
#   reason    why it is a report on this kind of product
# A file named group_<group>.add.tsv applies to every category of the group. Restart the server after editing.
invalid code|code\s+(?:is\s+)?(?:invalid|already used|already redeemed|expired|not working|doesn'?t work|did not work)|already\s+(?:used|redeemed)
